scope: Local Windows results only. Initial UNC-DLL diagnostics and Windows CI runner measurements are excluded.
warnings: Unrelated Windows Unity shader compilation, game, Defender and ChatGPT activity was observed by the supervising agent. Total CPU load reportedly reached 77%; no per-round contention/clock trace establishes quiet execution.
Warm single-model fork medians drift strongly; these distributions are observations, not unqualified speedup claims or clean performance qualification.
Native retention requires median <=80% and p95 <=100% of the fastest applicable FP64 JVM baseline on every required workload; missing/failed cases cannot be discarded.

Native cohort uses one CPU worker; requested maximum is four for all cohort engines. Strongest permitted JVM baseline may use four workers. This is reported rather than partitioned into a weaker native gate.

Cold calls have zero configured warmups and one measured round per JVM; their p95 is the maximum of only three observations. The CPU reference is trained before the measured candidate even with zero warmups, so these are not pristine-JVM first-instruction timings. Model/data preparation, parity checking and JVM process startup are outside the reported call total.
GPU clocks, power and per-kernel timings were not captured. Batch-size timing differences cannot be attributed to GPU arithmetic from this dataset.
Quality times are conditional on convergence; censored failures remain in the expected 32-seed denominator. Separate 10k/100k budgets are not pooled.
cuBLAS has only one JVM and three warmups: it is a separate descriptive comparison, not evidence for the three-fork gate.
JMH timings and GC allocation have different fixture scopes; see the JMH allocation caveat. CI measurements must remain separate by machine/revision/configuration.

policy.p95: nearest rank of all raw measured rounds
policy.forkIdentity: distinct processId:jvmStartMillis, at least three separate files
policy.qualityTimes: conditional on convergence; failures remain in the seed-run denominator
policy.localVerdict: Native candidate not retained on this evidence; clean CI assessment pending separately.

jmh.scope: Public mini-batch epoch time; each invocation trains ten epochs. JMH OperationsPerInvocation(10) reports one epoch.
jmh.allocationCaveat: gc.alloc.rate.norm includes Level.Invocation fixture construction/model/data/session setup and teardown in the allocation profiler interval, even though those fixtures are excluded from the timed benchmark method. It is not training-only allocation.
jmh.p95Caveat: These percentiles describe fifteen one-second iteration-average scores, not individual epoch latency.
